_doc: Known running loops (decision 035). A via on one of these `places` runs a full lap of the loop when the runner says around, loop of or lap of; `around_alone` places mean the lap when named on their own ("Central park reservor"). `names` are the loop's own names, which always mean the lap. `published_mi` and `source` are what the park says; `etl.build_running_loops` measures the ring from OSM and records both. `geometry: null` means the router can't run the loop yet: Loop says so and routes to it instead (rule 3). Keep this list short; anything not on it is a plain via.

loops.name: the Reservoir running track
loops.direction_source: Central Park Conservancy: the track is one-way, counterclockwise

loops.name: the Central Park drive loop
loops.direction_source: The drives' traffic direction (runners keep to the left lane)

loops.name: the Prospect Park drive loop
loops.length_note: OSM's drive ring measures 3.49 mi; the 3.35 mi most sources give is likely measured on the inside lane or without the bend at Grand Army Plaza. Loop counts the routed lap

loops.name: the McCarren Park track
loops.why_no_geometry: OSM maps the track as an area (leisure=track, way 4102021), not a path, so the router can't run on it
